verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents assigning a public IP so a machine is reachable over the internet, and enabling a private network at creation, with shared drives accessible across machines on that private network. Explicit port exposure, firewall or port-forwarding controls, and instance-to-instance private networking setup are not documented. missing for 10: documented port exposure/firewall configuration, details on connecting instances over the private network (subnets, addressing), independent hands-on corroboration of serving apps and private connectivity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking

citations.quote: Assign a public IP address to your machine to make it accessible over the internet
which features (like backups, public IP address, or private network) to enable or add
Shared drives provide storage that is accessible from multiple machines in a private network.
